_about: The attorney's appearance in immigration court (Form EOIR-28, Rev. Feb. 2025). Src/court.py. Filed alone: in the EOIR portal for an ECAS case, or on paper with the court, served on ICE (OPLA). No cover letter to USCIS and no exhibits. The attorney approves before use.
title: EOIR-28 (appearance in immigration court)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: An ECAS case: file the EOIR-28 in the EOIR portal with these answers instead of mailing the paper.
On paper: serve a copy on ICE (OPLA) for the court and complete the proof of service on page 2 before filing.
